events.evidence: Global oil prices fall to their lowest level since February 27, the day before the war started on February 28. Additionally, brent crude futures drop to US$73.50 a barrel
Ukrainian forces launch long-range drone strikes inside Russia, striking the Orenburg Gas Processing Plant
A doublet earthquake, consisting of a 7.2 foreshock and a 7.5 mainshock, strikes Yaracuy, Venezuela

label.note: Oil price drop supports risk appetite; Ukraine strikes and Venezuela earthquake add stress.
